justification: Insufficient modularization is present: `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/HashCodeBuilder.java` is 921 lines long and defines 32 public methods plus 9 private methods. The class mixes several responsibilities in one type: a mutable hash-code builder with `append(...)` overloads for every primitive and array type, `appendSuper`, `build`, `hashCode`, and `toHashCode`, plus a separate reflection-based API (`reflectionHashCode(...)` overloads) with cycle-detection/registry helpers (`reflectionAppend`, `register`, `unregister`). The tests in `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/HashCodeBuilderTest.java` and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/HashCodeBuilderAndEqualsBuilderTest.java` exercise both manual append and reflection-based behavior, reinforcing that the class bundles multiple separable concerns.
